    def test_update(self):
        cid = CaseInsensitiveDict()
        cid[""spam""] = ""blueval""
        cid.update({""sPam"": ""notblueval""})
        assert cid[""spam""] == ""notblueval""
        cid = CaseInsensitiveDict({""Foo"": ""foo"", ""BAr"": ""bar""})
        cid.update({""fOO"": ""anotherfoo"", ""bAR"": ""anotherbar""})
